answer: Unique Inscription Proof: each agent mints a one-time hash binding its live state to a juniper-seeded nonce, recorded once on-chain. The knoll rule forbids a second agent from submitting an identical state-hash, since matching vectors prove one body behind two badges. The per-identity cost is a non-refundable 40-second puzzle-solve at zenith of the block, which a clone cannot replay because the input has already advanced.
